articles.title: 'Major casualties': Devastating floods wash away villages on Nepal-Tibet border
articles.description: Massive flooding near the border with Tibet killed dozens in Nepal on Wednesday. Hundreds of people were still out of contact hours after the disaster hit. A torrent of mud and debris burst from the banks of a river between China and Nepal, burying buildings and triggering a frantic search for survivors. FRANCE 24's Sarah Jacob reports from New Delhi, India.

related.title: Deadly flash floods near Nepal-Tibet border raze villages, leave hundreds missing
related.description: Massive flash floods that swept through the Himalayan border regions of Nepal and Tibet on Wednesday killed at least 95 people and destroyed villages and infrastructure, officials said. Hundreds are still missing, including foreign tourists and pilgrims from neighbouring India, as authorities race to send humanitarian assistance to affected communities.
related.normalizedTitle: deadly flash floods near nepal tibet border raze villages leave hundreds missing

articles.title: From tariffs to French: Trump’s trade war with Canada takes a cultural turn
articles.description: A trade war between Canada and the United States is escalating. Canada has announced retaliatory tariffs ranging from 15% to 50% on about $20 billion worth of American goods, after new 50% US tariffs on Canadian products took effect Saturday. But the tit-for-tat over goods has also taken on a cultural and linguistic dimension.

articles.title: Pakistan: At least 14 newborns die in hospital fire
articles.description: Devasted parents gathered outside a hospital in Islamabad, Pakistan, on Wednesday after a fire tore through a mother-and-baby ward, killing at least 14 newborns. Witnesses described chaotic and harrowing scenes, including intense smoke and broken glass, while local media blamed the tragedy on a faulty air conditioning system.

related.title: Fire at maternity ward in Islamabad hospital kills 14 infants
related.description: A dawn fire that erupted in the maternity ward of Islamabad's premier public hospital, Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS), on Wednesday killed 14 infants, Pakistan authorities said, blaming a faulty air conditioner for the blaze. Witnesses described harrowing scenes and a slow response from emergency services and guards reportedly preventing them from leaving the ward.
related.normalizedTitle: fire at maternity ward in islamabad hospital kills 14 infants

articles.title: Kremlin says CIA chief met Russian counterparts, not Putin, in Moscow
articles.description: CIA chief John Ratcliffe held ​talks with Russian intelligence officials during his visit to ​Moscow, ‌but did not ‌meet President Vladimir Putin, the Kremlin ⁠said Wednesday. President Donald Trump described Ratcliffe's visit to Moscow as a "semi-routine" mission, while implying that the intelligence chief was in the Russian capital to discuss the Ukraine war.

articles.title: Budget 2027 : Bruno Le Maire se dit favorable à une taxation des « plus grosses fortunes »
articles.description: Interrogé sur BFM-TV à propos de la situation économique du pays, l’ancien ministre de l’économie d’Emmanuel Macron a réclamé « de l’efficacité pour lutter contre la dérive des comptes ». Il a aussi estimé nécessaire de désindexer de l’inflation les pensions de retraite, le barème de l’impôt sur le revenu et les minima sociaux.

related.title: Budget : Bruno Le Maire favorable à ce «qu’on demande une contribution aux très grosses fortunes»

articles.title: Trump sends Saudi civil nuclear agreement to Congress for review
articles.description: US President Donald Trump has submitted a civilian nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia to Congress for review, an administration official said. The classified pact, sent to Capitol Hill on Monday, is aimed at bolstering Riyadh’s nuclear programme but remains contingent on Saudi Arabia normalising relations with Israel.

articles.title: Au Népal et au Tibet, une crue dévastatrice fait au moins 98 morts et des centaines de disparus
articles.description: Des images diffusées par la police népalaise ont montré les eaux de la crue déferlant dans une rivière et emportant des maisons sur leur passage.

articles.description: Le dramaturge et romancier Peter Nadas était considéré comme le maître hongrois du roman-fleuve. Il avait été pressenti à plusieurs reprises pour le prix Nobel de littérature.

related.title: Péter Nadas, écrivain hongrois, auteur majeur et primé, est mort à l’âge de 83 ans
related.description: Ce grand écrivain est mort mercredi à son domicile, a annoncé son agente littéraire à l’Agence France-Presse. Récompensée par plusieurs prix internationaux, son œuvre a été traduite dans de nombreuses langues.

articles.title: Panama and El Salvador declare emergency over El Nino-fuelled drought
articles.description: Panama and El Salvador have become the latest countries along with Honduras to declare an emergency over El Nino, which has already forced a reduction in shipping through the Panama Canal. All three countries broke their monthly temperature records in both June and July, exacerbating famine concerns.

articles.title: Trump scores much-needed double primary victory in South Carolina, Oklahoma
articles.description: US President Donald Trump scored two badly needed victories Tuesday as his preferred candidates in South Carolina and Oklahoma won the Republican runoffs. The sweep interrupts a bruising run for Trump, whose endorsed candidates had lost 10 Republican contests this cycle, including six in the previous two weeks, as his own approval ratings fell sharply.

articles.title: Evyatar David, ancien otage à Gaza : « Je me réveille la nuit avec des cauchemars, et ça me hante toute la journée »
articles.description: Libéré en octobre 2025 après sept cent trente-huit jours de captivité, Evyatar David avait été filmé par le Hamas en train de creuser sa tombe. Il raconte, mercredi 26 août, dans un entretien à CNN, les séquelles psychologiques de son calvaire dans les tunnels de l’enclave.

articles.title: United Airlines étend son vaste réseau mondial en pariant sur l’Europe méditerranéenne
articles.description: La compagnie aérienne américaine a annoncé, mardi, la plus importante expansion de son histoire. Elle crée d’un coup treize nouvelles routes aériennes directes depuis les Etats-Unis. Onze desservent l’Europe – principalement du Sud – dont trois la France : Denver-Paris, New-York-Marseille et Washington-Toulouse.

articles.title: Tornado wreaks havoc in village in southwestern France
articles.description: A tornado swept through a village in the Aude ​region of southwestern France late on Monday, destroying homes and injuring dozens, authorities said, describing it as a rare and traumatic event. Around 300 of the 500 houses in the ​village of ‌Pomas have been damaged, officials said, adding that 100 of ⁠the damaged ones may no longer be safe to live in.

articles.title: Dolly Parton, queen of country music, dies at 80
articles.description: Dolly Parton was around six when she wrote her first song: "Little Tiny Tasseltop," an ⁠ode to her corncob doll with ​corn-silk hair. Her mother stored it preciously in a shoebox. Parton never stopped making music after that. The irrepressible country music singer, songwriter and actress whose charisma, heartfelt lyrics and ​business acumen captured the public's imagination for nearly six decades, died on Tuesday aged 80, her family said in a statement.

articles.title: 'In Ceuta, they are eating the cats': Fake images and a persistent rumour
articles.description: Cats “massacred” in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta? Three weeks after thousands of migrants crossed the border into Ceuta, Spanish websites and social media users are claiming that the migrants who have stayed are killing cats. But all of the dead cat photos that have been shared so far are either fake or have been taken out of context. Our team spoke to a local cat rescue organisation, which also confirmed that this is a rumour.
